claims.text: Cushing screening: one of late-night salivary cortisol, 24-hour urine free cortisol, or the 1-mg overnight dexamethasone suppression test.
claims.quote: 1 of: late-night salivary cortisol, 24-hr urine free cortisol, or 1-mg overnight dexamethasone suppression test

claims.text: One test may not be enough: two or more abnormal screening tests are recommended.
claims.quote: 1 test poss insuff -> 2+ abnorm screening tests = recommended

claims.text: Find the cause: baseline ACTH and high-dose dexamethasone, then targeted imaging or sampling.
claims.quote: Find eti of ↑cortisol: baseline ACTH + high dose dexamethasone & targeting imaging/sampling as indicated

claims.text: Adrenal insufficiency: low morning cortisol with high ACTH; confirm with the cosyntropin stimulation test.
claims.quote: Dx: ↓morning cortisol w ↑ACTH; confirm w cosyntropin stim test (high dose ACTH test)

claims.text: Cosyntropin test: give 250 µg cosyntropin and measure cortisol at 30 and 60 minutes.
claims.quote: give 250 ug cosyntropin & measure cortisol at 30 & 60 min

claims.text: Primary hyperaldosteronism: aldosterone:renin ratio is the screening test; adrenal vein sampling lateralizes.
claims.quote: Aldosterone:renin ratio ↑↑ (screening test); adrenal adenoma or bilateral hyperplasia; hypertension, hypokalemia, metabolic alkalosis; adrenal vein sampling to lateralize
